subject: TruSight trial prep — sample prompt inventory & success gates
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@trusighthealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + sample prompt/log request

Hi Rajesh — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we’re aligned before we kick off the POC:

1) Goal/success criteria (for POC):
- Demonstrate 2-week trial where Redwood serves TruSight NLU tasks against your real prompt set and evaluation harness.
- Acceptance (initial): intent accuracy >= 90% (top-1), hallucination rate < 2% on critical intent classes, inference p95 latency < 350ms for our target 256-token window.

2) Deliverables from TruSight:
- Sample prompt inventory (1k–1.5k examples) representative of live traffic (mix of short queries, multi-turn support logs, and structured forms).
- Ground-truth labels where available (intent, expected entities, expected answer span). If labels are not available, we will run a blind eval and review results together.
- A small set (50–100) of high-risk prompts you want prioritized for manual review.

3) Transfer & security options we can support:
- S3 (preferred): you can upload to a pre-signed bucket; we’ll provide an upload policy and retention TTL.
- Secure box: shared Drive link with access control.
- If either option isn’t possible, we can set up private rsync over a customer VPC (requires scheduling).

4) Timeline & owners:
- Data delivery target: Aug 24 (you indicated next week is possible).
- Trial kickoff: Aug 28 — run evaluation for ~10 business days.
- Owners: Ben (sales) — commercial/acceptance; Evelyn (solutions) — eval plan & criteria; Marcus (engineering) — ingestion & infra.

5) Next steps (your action items):
- Share sample prompt file (CSV or JSONL) and any labeling/PIO guidance.
- Confirm which transfer mechanism you prefer.

I’m attaching a short prompt-spec template you can fill (trusight-prompt-spec-template.csv). Marcus will follow up with technical upload instructions once we know the transfer path.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: trusight-prompt-spec-template.csv (CSV template with columns: id, user_text, context, label_intent, label_entities, redaction_flag)

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@trusighthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@trusighthealth.com>, TruSight Procurement <procurement@trusighthealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + sample prompt/log request

Thanks Ben — appreciated the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Format: we can provide either CSV or JSONL. Our internal support logs are semi-structured (conversation turns). Would Redwood prefer JSONL with a "turns" array per row?
- Labels: we have intent labels for ~70% of traffic; the remainder will be unlabeled. Is that OK?
- PII: we need to confirm the PII redaction requirements. We can provide a de-identified copy if that speed things up.

I’ve attached a short sample (ts_sample_prompts.csv) showing the shape of our data (3 example rows). Procurement looped in to confirm the timing for any data transfer process.

We’d like to propose target delivery of 1,200 de-identified prompts by Aug 24. Please confirm that sample size works for the evaluation plan and that JSONL turn format is acceptable. Also please share the upload instructions and retention policy so procurement can review.

Thanks — Rajesh
Head of Product | TruSight Health
rajesh@trusighthealth.com

Attachments: ts_sample_prompts.csv (3 sample prompt rows; includes a short conversation, label_intent where present)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@trusighthealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + sample prompt/log request

Rajesh — thanks, that all sounds workable. Quick answers and the plan from a solutions/engineering perspective: 

1) Format & ingestion: JSONL with a "turns" array is fine and often preferred for multi-turn logs. If you send CSV, include a column with serialized JSON for the turn sequence. We’ll accept either.

2) Labels: partial labels are fine. Redwood’s eval runner will run both labeled and unlabeled metrics; for unlabeled examples we’ll use a panel review and surface examples to prioritize.

3) PII & de-identification: we strongly encourage de-identification before transfer. If you cannot fully de-identify, we can provide a transient, encrypted S3 upload area with strict retention (48 hours by default) and an NDA addendum for the trial. Procurement — you should see the upload policy link below.

4) Evaluation plan (summary):
- Metrics: top-1 intent accuracy, top-3 intent recall, entity F1 for labeled data, hallucination count (manually reviewed), and average cost per 1k tokens.
- Acceptance gates: top-1 intent accuracy >= 90% OR a mutually agreed plan to reach it by next milestone; p95 latency < 300ms on our hosted config; critical intents (3 classes) require >= 95% precision.
- Reporting: we’ll deliver a short readout (dashboard + PDF) at the end of run with example failures and suggested prompt/temperature adjustments.

5) Timeline & milestones:
- Aug 24: Data delivery (1.2k rows)
- Aug 28: Trial kickoff (model pinned + ingestion complete)
- Sep 7: Mid-run check-in & preliminary readout
- Sep 11: Final readout and recommendation memo

6) Ownership & contacts:
- Redwood: Ben (commercial), Evelyn (eval plan lead), Marcus (technical ingestion / infra)
- TruSight: Rajesh (product), Aisha (data lead), Procurement contact (procurement@trusighthealth.com)

I’m attaching our upload instructions (redwood-upload-instructions.md) and a short template for the eval rubric. For transfer we can provision a time-limited pre-signed S3 bucket and a short retention TTL (48 hours). Procurement — please advise if a shared Drive is required for compliance and we’ll coordinate alternatives.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4872) and a shared Drive folder for the trial materials (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cTrusightTrial).

If this plan looks good, Rajesh — please confirm the transfer method and we’ll provision the bucket and send credentials. Marcus will reach out with a short checklist for JSONL fields and a small ingestion test you can run locally.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-upload-instructions.md (step-by-step S3 presigned upload, retention policy, contact for private transfer)

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@trusighthealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@trusighthealth.com>, TruSight Procurement <procurement@trusighthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + sample prompt/log request

Thanks Evelyn — that all reads well. We’ll proceed with de-identified JSONL (turns array) and aim to upload ~1,200 rows by Aug 24. Procurement is happy with a pre-signed S3 upload and the 48-hour retention window — they asked for the exact ACL and TTL in the upload instructions which you supplied.

Marcus (cc’d) — can you send a quick intro and the ingestion checklist so our data engineer can run the local test this week?

We’ll also schedule the kickoff for Aug 28 at 09:00 PT — can your team confirm availability?

Best regards,
Rajesh Patel
Head of Product | TruSight Health
rajesh@trusighthealth.com
